required_input_schema.paper_exact_layout_instances: initial and target atom coordinates for each plotted family
required_input_schema.routing_instances: typed moves, collision constraints, and precedence graph
required_input_schema.scheduler_contract: AOD/SLM resource limits and aggregation rules
required_input_schema.hardware_timing_parameters: move, transfer, acceleration, and cycle-time constants

forbidden_substitutions: guessed circuits, schedules, layouts, or benchmark metadata
acceptance_boundary: Run independent routing and scheduling for every layout and derive curves, transfers, and maximum speed from generated trajectories.
